semiconductor_relevance: High — KITZ SCT Corporation specializes in ultra-high purity fluid system components essential for semiconductor manufacturing processes.
summary: KITZ SCT Corporation is a leading manufacturer of ultra-high purity components for gas and chemical delivery systems in semiconductor fabrication. Their product offerings include valves, fittings, and subsystems designed to support both conventional and next-generation semiconductor manufacturing processes.
